# FINDING_ID: # F01 -- the ledger membership accepted a PREFIX of a record.  The fix requires an EXACT record: the same LENGTH, the same BYTES and a terminated line.
# F02 -- the archive member name was bounded by the sixteen-byte name field.  The fix bounds it by the SOURCE SLICE and allocates from the decoded length.
# F03 -- the Mach-O segment and section extents were read at the wrong width, and the thirty-two-bit section offset was read at the wrong width.  The fix reads each field at its own width.
# F04 -- the LC_DYSYMTAB tables were not all validated, and the symbol-range relationships were not checked.  The fix validates all six tables with the correct widths and the relationships.
# F05 -- the archive's EMBEDDED objects were never validated.  The fix validates each real member's payload as an embedded Mach-O object, on each side independently.
# F06 -- a warm build accepted a stale producer and a stale archive.  The fix requalifies both at the acceptance boundary, on every run.
# F07 -- the archive name allocation could overrun.  The fix uses the decoded length, bounds the source copy and guards the allocation.

# F08 -- the execution provenance did not bind the observation to the execution: the comparator never recomputed the event identity, the harness never applied the environment it recorded, the runner never checked the producer it was about to execute, the event directory was not allocated exclusively, and the event identity was computed over a reversed counter.
